title: A Safety-Aware Role-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Behavioral Health Communication Simulation
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety and clinical appropriateness within a behavioral health communication framework. While it includes an 'ethical appropriateness' audit as part of its multi-agent architecture and evaluation metrics, this is presented as a component of clinical safety and response quality rather than a study or benchmark of religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or formal ethical frameworks.
